title: T1683 — Generate Content
subtitle: Interactive walkthrough of Generate Content with the technique-specific attack path and defender evidence.
aria: Animated simulation of an attacker using AI to generate a fake job applicant identity, with defender evidence at each step

steps.title: Pick the target job
steps.caption: The attacker studies a job posting and the company website. They learn which skills, certificates, and tools the company wants. public job posts tell attackers exactly what to fake.
steps.defender: IdP and SaaS audit logs record token issuance, consent, sign-in location and API access.

steps.title: Draft the resume with AI
steps.caption: The attacker prompts a generative AI service to write a resume that matches the posting. The text is fluent and tailored. Nothing touches your network yet, so your logs show nothing. this is the part you cannot see, which is why later steps matter.
steps.defender: IdP and SaaS audit logs record token issuance, consent, sign-in location and API access.
